en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, from Abu Baseer from, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘Four’, no harm is entered upon them with regards to the inheritance – the two parents, and the husband, and the wife’.
en.sarwar: 2. Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah, from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jabalah from abu al-Mighra’ from Ibrahim ibn Maymun from Salim al-Ashal who has narrated the following: “He had heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has placed the parents with all other heirs and [nothing] from their one-sixth is reduced.
He has placed husband and wife with heirs and [nothing] is reduced from one-fourth and one-eighth.’”
